_readme: Template only. Copy to detection_source.json (or to detection_source.batch.json, and name that in the "_include" of detection.json) in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: other configs pull it in with "_include", so it is set once. The batch form of what steps 5 and 6 run the detectors on: a folder of videos / frame folders against a folder of label folders. Each camera video becomes one input of the run, which is what the 3D steps work on.

dataset._readme: Each entry in 'inputs' (a video file, or a folder of frames) is paired with the folder in 'labels' whose name matches it exactly, or contains it (e.g. video 'clip_01.mp4' <-> labels 'ft3_15_clip_01'). Each label folder can hold the .txt files directly or be a CVAT/YOLO export root (labels/<split>/*.txt + data.yaml). The settings below apply to every pair. Each pair gets its own sub-folder in the run folder; run-level results pool all pairs.
dataset.name: my_batch
